text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! It's nothing. We're doing race 
analysis today, right? Well then—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I have a slight headache. Usually it 
goes away quickly, but..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... This is quite a pickle. But I'm 
really fine, promise! Let's get started—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She clearly wasn't doing well. Though I 
halted the analysis, her headache showed 
no signs of letting up...
